subject: general
question: Which among the following Constitutional Amendment Act of the Indian constitution reduced the age of voting from 21 to 18 for elections to the Lok Sabha and to the Legislative Assemblies of states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Constitutional Amendment Act that reduced the age of voting from 21 to 18 for elections to the Lok Sabha and the Legislative Assemblies of states is the 61st Constitutional Amendment Act of 1988.**
 
• This amendment lowered the voting age in India, making it more inclusive and allowing a larger section of the population to participate in the electoral process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Constitutional amendment acts are generally regarded as important tools for adapting a constitution to the changing needs and aspirations of a society.
 
• However, due to the significance and potential long-lasting effects of constitutional changes, they often require careful deliberation, public consultation, and broad consensus to ensure that they truly reflect the will of the people and maintain the integrity of the constitutional framework.
